rationale: The full feminine sound plural مَقْصُورَات follows مَفْعُولَات. Its feminine singular مَقْصُورَة follows مَفْعُولَة; the masculine base مَقْصُور follows مَفْعُول. The original note attaches the bare masculine-base pattern to the complete feminine plural without qualification. Correcting that pattern and explicitly naming the plural preserves its passive-participle derivation and existing contextual meaning.
